ns2:course.label: Techniques of Remote Sensing
ns2:course.description: Optical and digital information processing of imagery acquired from aircraft and satellite remote sensing platforms; includes systems design, mensuration theory, photographic enhancement techniques, and automatic digital classification for all of the standard sensor systems; and laboratory focusing on the design and implementation of information processing techniques with application limited to a survey of uses. Prerequisite: GEOG 470 and GEOG 477, or equivalent.
